dialogues.speaker: Records Left in the Terminal
dialogues.text: "...Observations of the intermittently visible celestial body indicate a tenuous atmosphere on its surface... No signs of life activity have been detected so far, though parts of its surface structures do not appear to be naturally formed..."

dialogues.speaker: Records Left in the Terminal
dialogues.text: "...Although I have expelled the oath-breaker Ungien from the team, his lunar biosphere work and nearby test sites may still be useful for landing on that star... Heh... but let's not dwell on him..."

dialogues.speaker: Records Left in the Terminal
dialogues.text: "...May the Creator be forever crowned with supreme glory. We shall journey toward the stars, as we once gazed upon the moon from the earth."
